comment: calendar.c time_from_yyyymmddhhmmss() (recorder patch 001) and rip.c genl_outrip(): year 9999 with month 15 carries into year 10000, and day 59, hour 26, minute 75 and second 99 carry on to 10000-04-29 03:16:39 EDT. The same debug Samurai as time_from_yyyymmddhhmmss-out-of-range-fields-full-moon zaps a wished-for wand of death at himself; the tombstone prints (yyyymmdd() / 10000) % 10000, which is 0 for year 10000. The datetime is out of range on purpose, so the segment sets datetimeOutOfRange.
